# Harmonized Field Boundary Data

Official (non-AI) field boundaries harmonized to fiboa, 43 collections, GeoParquet + PMTiles on Source Cooperative. Root: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/catalog.json. Agent guide: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/AGENTS.md.

- at: Field boundaries for Austria — https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/at/latest/at.parquet (license CC-BY-4.0, CRS EPSG:31287)
- at_block: Field boundaries for Austria — https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/at_block/latest/at_block.parquet (license CC-BY-4.0, CRS EPSG:31287)
- be_vlg: Field boundaries for Flanders, Belgium — https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_vlg/latest/be_vlg.parquet (license other, CRS EPSG:31370)
- be_wal: Belgium Wallonia: Parcellaire Agricole Anonyme — https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/be_wal/latest/be_wal.parquet (license other, CRS EPSG:3035)
- ch: Field boundaries for Switzerland — https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/latest/ch.parquet (license other, CRS EPSG:2056)
- cz: Field boundaries for Czech — https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/cz/latest/cz.parquet (license CC0-1.0, CRS EPSG:4258)

Globs need S3 through the proxy (DuckDB: CREATE SECRET sc (TYPE s3, PROVIDER config, ENDPOINT 'data.source.coop', URL_STYLE 'path', REGION 'us-west-2')): all newest editions s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/*/latest/*.parquet (union_by_name=true); per-edition s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/<id>/year=*/*.parquet (hive_partitioning=true).
